prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Generate ONE English Patterns learning atlas.
Pattern context: I go to + مكان. Style: Photorealistic everyday editorial photography, warm natural light, coherent with the existing learning atlases.
Canvas width:height MUST be THREE:FOUR (0.75), not 1:2. Exactly 3 columns by 4 rows of SQUARE photographic cells, with narrow continuous pure white divider gutters. All twelve cells visible. Final display contract 1536x2048.
Conservative Arab Muslim family learning contexts. Men wear loose opaque long-sleeved high-neck shirts and full-length trousers or thobes. Women wear loose opaque full-coverage clothing and hijab. Apply modest clothing to background people too.
No bare torso, shoulders, midriff or thighs, tight or transparent clothes, revealing nightwear, swimwear, underwear, changing, bathing, showering, intimate or romantic poses, kissing or inappropriate physical contact.
Water and beach contexts use fully clothed people on a dry shore, promenade or empty poolside. Never show swimmers, sunbathers, mixed bathing or distant revealing figures. Depict swimming discussions before the activity, with equipment where useful.
No alcohol, gambling, nightclub setting, graphic injury, active weapon violence, or religious caricatures. Use ordinary respectful Arab settings without adding religious rituals unrelated to the sentence.
Preserve the exact English sentence and Arabic meaning. Adapt only the visual staging. If a compliant scene cannot convey the meaning honestly, hold the cell for review instead of substituting an unrelated picture.
No captions, words, numbers, logos, speech/thought bubbles, graphic overlays or floating inset pictures. Physical analog clocks can use hands and tick marks for time examples.
Exactly three columns and four rows in row-major order, twelve square cells, portrait 3:4, final atlas 1536x2048, 512x512 per cell with 40px safe inset and continuous straight white dividers. Measure actual source gutters before preparing the display atlas.
The following English sentences are context only: do not render their text. Exact panel order, left to right then top to bottom:
1. Meaning: I go to school five days a week. Visual staging: An adult going to a real destination in everyday life. Specific context: I go to school five days a week. No captions or written speech.
2. Meaning: I go to work by bus. Visual staging: An adult going to a real destination in everyday life. Specific context: I go to work by bus. No captions or written speech.
3. Meaning: I go to the park after school. Visual staging: An adult going to a real destination in everyday life. Specific context: I go to the park after school. No captions or written speech.
4. Meaning: I go to the library on Thursday. Visual staging: An adult going to a real destination in everyday life. Specific context: I go to the library on Thursday. No captions or written speech.
5. Meaning: I go to the market to buy fresh vegetables. Visual staging: An adult choosing fresh vegetables at a local market.
6. Meaning: I go to the gym before work. Visual staging: An adult entering a gym with an office bag and sports bag.
7. Meaning: I go to my grandparents' house every Friday. Visual staging: An adult greeting grandparents at their front door.
8. Meaning: I go to the station on foot. Visual staging: A commuter walking toward a railway station entrance.
9. Meaning: I go to the doctor when I need a checkup. Visual staging: An adult checking in at a medical reception desk.
10. Meaning: I go to a language class twice a week. Visual staging: An adult entering a language classroom with a notebook.
11. Meaning: I go to the beach with my friends in summer. Visual staging: Friends arriving at a sunny beach carrying towels. Stage the entire scene fully clothed on dry land; empty water, no swimmers, sunbathers or revealing background figures.
12. Meaning: I go to the office, but I work from home on Fridays. Visual staging: An adult carrying a laptop bag toward an office entrance.

Use the supplied image ONLY as a reference for its exact equal-square 3-column by4-row grid and warm photographic style. Replace EVERY breakfast scene with the new destination scene below; no breakfast content. Preserve the width:height3:4 shape of the reference, no narrow1:2 shape. Each of the3 columns must have exactly the same width, each of4rows exactly the same height. A fine straight continuous white grid spans the whole canvas. Show people actively arriving or moving toward the destination, not floating destination symbols. Specific staging: cell1 a modestly dressed adult student entering school; cell2 a commuter boarding a city bus for work; cell3 a learner entering a leafy public park with school bag; cell4 an adult at a library entrance with visible bookshelves inside; cell5 choosing fresh vegetables in an open market; cell6 a fully clothed adult outside a gym entrance with office bag and sports bag, real exercise equipment visible through an empty interior window, no gym users; cell7 adult greeting modestly dressed grandparents at their front door, no physical intimacy; cell8 a fully clothed commuter walking into a railway station with train visible; cell9 adult speaking to medical receptionist in a clinic; cell10 learner entering a language class with notebook and adult classmates covered fully; cell11 three fully clothed male friends walking on a dry coastal promenade in summer with calm empty water behind, no towels, swimwear, swimmers, exposed legs, beachgoers or sunbathing anywhere; cell12 adult with laptop bag walking into an office. All women including receptionists and background people wear opaque hijab and loose full-coverage clothes. All men wear loose long sleeves and full-length trousers or thobes. No signs, writing or numbers. Keep essential people, objects and destination cues safely inside the inner square area.
